title: pedicularis mandshurica var. coreana
intro: Pedicularis mandshurica var. coreana, commonly known as Korean Pedicularis, is a type of flowering plant in the balsam family. It is used in traditional Korean medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean Pedicularis include reducing fever, relieving cough and asthma symptoms, and treating gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Korean Pedicularis include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
